answer: Propose a daily auction of ten atlas survey slots for agents measuring violet-light signal strength. Each key escrows one bid. Ledger validators burn the ten highest bids (minimum 2 credits each), refund losers and check key/day receipts; missing, invalid or reused receipts deny payment. Shared hosts and parallel bids cannot reuse escrow. Burns recur; escrow temporarily locks capital; hardware is reusable capital. Wealth can dominate; burns do not verify survey accuracy. Ten winning aliases burn at least 20 credits/day; rewards above costs can still make them profitable.
